The present invention relates to a synthesis process for the triketone-class herbicide tembotrione, comprising the following steps: 1) synthesis of 2-chloro-6-(methanesulfonyl)toluene; 2) synthesis of 2-chloro-3-acetyl-6-(methanesulfonyl)toluene; 3) synthesis of 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid; 4) synthesis of methyl 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate; 5) synthesis of methyl 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate; 6) synthesis of 2-chloro-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid; 7) synthesis of 3-oxo-1-cyclohexen-1-yl 2-chloro-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate; 8) synthesis of tembotrione. Abstract. The present invention relates to a synthesis process for the triketone-class herbicide tembotrione, comprising the following steps: 1) synthesis of 2-chloro-6-(methanesulfonyl)toluene; 2) synthesis of 2-chloro-3-acetyl-6-(methanesulfonyl)toluene; 3) synthesis of 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid; 4) synthesis of methyl 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate; 5) synthesis of methyl 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate; 6) synthesis of 2-chloro-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid; 7) synthesis of 3-oxo-1-cyclohexen-1-yl 2-chloro-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate; 8) synthesis of tembotrione. Into a 500 ml four-necked reaction flask fitted with a stirrer, a thermometer and a condenser were charged methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate 55.8 g (0.2 mol), sodium trifluoroethoxide 28.1 g (0.23 mol) and 100 ml THF solvent; stirred at room temperature for 16 h, then washed with water and concentrated to give ethyl 2-chloro-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate; sodium hydroxide 9.2 g (0.23 mol) and water 10 ml were added and the mixture refluxed for 4 h. claims.evidence_en: Title of invention: Synthesis process for the triketone-class herbicide tembotrione Title of invention: Synthesis process for the triketone-class herbicide tembotrione Title of invention: Synthesis process for the triketone-class herbicide tembotrione Abstract. The present invention relates to a synthesis process for the triketone-class herbicide tembotrione, comprising the following steps: 1) synthesis of 2-chloro-6-(methanesulfonyl)toluene; 2) synthesis of 2-chloro-3-acetyl-6-(methanesulfonyl)toluene; 3) synthesis of 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid; 4) synthesis of methyl 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate; 5) synthesis of methyl 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate; 6) synthesis of 2-chloro-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid; 7) synthesis of 3-oxo-1-cyclohexen-1-yl 2-chloro-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate; 8) synthesis of tembotrione. The beneficial effects of the present invention are that: the reaction steps and time are shortened, and the yield of the intermediates is raised; the reaction conditions are milder and safer; the cost is lowered. Abstract. The present invention relates to a synthesis process for the triketone-class herbicide tembotrione, comprising the following steps: 1) synthesis of 2-chloro-6-(methanesulfonyl)toluene; 2) synthesis of 2-chloro-3-acetyl-6-(methanesulfonyl)toluene; 3) synthesis of 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid; 4) synthesis of methyl 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate; 5) synthesis of methyl 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate; 6) synthesis of 2-chloro-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid; 7) synthesis of 3-oxo-1-cyclohexen-1-yl 2-chloro-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate; 8) synthesis of tembotrione. The beneficial effects of the present invention are that: the reaction steps and time are shortened, and the yield of the intermediates is raised; the reaction conditions are milder and safer; the cost is lowered.

Abstract. The present invention relates to a synthesis process for the triketone-class herbicide tembotrione, comprising the following steps: 1) synthesis of 2-chloro-6-(methanesulfonyl)toluene; 2) synthesis of 2-chloro-3-acetyl-6-(methanesulfonyl)toluene; 3) synthesis of 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid; 4) synthesis of methyl 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate; 5) synthesis of methyl 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate; 6) synthesis of 2-chloro-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid; 7) synthesis of 3-oxo-1-cyclohexen-1-yl 2-chloro-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate; 8) synthesis of tembotrione. The beneficial effects of the present invention are that: the reaction steps and time are shortened, and the yield of the intermediates is raised; the reaction conditions are milder and safer; the cost is lowered.

Into a 500 ml four-necked reaction flask fitted with a stirrer, a thermometer and a reflux condenser were charged 2-chloro-6-(methylsulfonyl)toluene 34.0 g (0.2 mol), anhydrous aluminium trichloride 40.5 g (0.3 mol) and dichloromethane; at a temperature of 15-20°C, acetyl chloride 23.5 g (0.3 mol) was added dropwise; after the addition was complete, the reaction was continued at room temperature for 5 h; when the reaction was complete, the reaction mixture was poured into a mixture of ice water and hydrochloric acid, the organic layer was separated, the aqueous layer was extracted with dichloromethane, the organic layers were combined, washed with water and concentrated to give 36.5 g of 2-chloro-3-acetyl-6-(methylsulfonyl)toluene as a white solid, yield 86％, melting point 110-112°C.

2) Synthesis of 2-chloro-3-acetyl-6-methylsulfonyltoluene

2-Chloro-6-methylsulfonyltoluene, anhydrous aluminium trichloride and solvent are charged into a reaction vessel; acetyl chloride is added dropwise at a temperature of 15-20℃; after the dropwise addition is complete the reaction is continued at room temperature for 1-5 h; when the reaction is complete the reaction mixture is poured into a mixture of ice water and hydrochloric acid; the organic layer is separated off, the aqueous layer is extracted with solvent, the organic layers are combined, washed with water and concentrated to give 2-chloro-3-acetyl-6-methylsulfonyltoluene;

Into a reaction vessel fitted with a stirrer are charged separately the 2-chloro-3-acetyl-6-methylsulfonyltoluene obtained in step 2) and aqueous sodium hypochlorite solution; the mixture is heated to react, acidified with dilute hydrochloric acid, filtered, washed with water and dried to give 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid;

According to the above scheme, in step 2) the molar ratio of 2-chloro-6-methylsulfonyltoluene, anhydrous aluminium trichloride and acetyl chloride is 1:1-5:1-2, and said solvent is dichloromethane, chloroform or 1,2-dichloroethane.

evidence_lines.text_en: 5) Synthesis of methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate
5) Synthesis of methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate

Methyl 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate is dissolved in a solvent, an appropriate amount of peroxybenzoic acid is added, bromine is added dropwise under reflux conditions, and after the addition is complete the reaction is continued for 1-10 h, cooled, washed with water and concentrated to give methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate;

Methyl 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate is dissolved in a solvent, an appropriate amount of peroxybenzoic acid is added, bromine is added dropwise under reflux conditions, and after the addition is complete the reaction is continued for 1-10 h, cooled, washed with water and concentrated to give methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate;

Methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate is dissolved in a solvent, sodium 2,2,2-trifluoroethoxide is added, the mixture is stirred at room temperature, then washed with water and concentrated to give ETHYL 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate; the residue is dissolved in a solvent, aqueous sodium hydroxide solution is added, the mixture is refluxed for 1-4 h, cooled, acidified by addition of dilute hydrochloric acid, extracted with solvent, washed with water, dried and concentrated to give 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid;

Methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate is dissolved in a solvent, sodium 2,2,2-trifluoroethoxide is added, the mixture is stirred at room temperature, then washed with water and concentrated to give ETHYL 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate; the residue is dissolved in a solvent, aqueous sodium hydroxide solution is added, the mixture is refluxed for 1-4 h, cooled, acidified by addition of dilute hydrochloric acid, extracted with solvent, washed with water, dried and concentrated to give 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid;

According to the above scheme, in step 6) the molar ratio of methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate to sodium trifluoroethoxide is 1:1-1.5, and said solvent is tetrahydrofuran, acetonitrile, dichloromethane or toluene.

According to the above scheme, in step 6) the molar ratio of methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate to sodium trifluoroethoxide is 1:1-1.5, and said solvent is tetrahydrofuran, acetonitrile, dichloromethane or toluene.

7) Synthesis of 3-oxo-1-cyclohexen-1-yl 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate

2-Chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid, N,N-dimethylformamide and a solvent are charged into a reaction flask; at room temperature thionyl chloride is added dropwise, the temperature is raised and the mixture is stirred at reflux, the solvent is distilled off, dichloromethane is added to the residue, and after cooling a mixture of cyclohexanedione and a base is added and stirred at room temperature; the reaction mixture is washed with water, dried and concentrated to give, as an oil, 3-oxo-1-cyclohexen-1-yl 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate;

2-Chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid, N,N-dimethylformamide and a solvent are charged into a reaction flask; at room temperature thionyl chloride is added dropwise, the temperature is raised and the mixture is stirred at reflux, the solvent is distilled off, dichloromethane is added to the residue, and after cooling a mixture of cyclohexanedione and a base is added and stirred at room temperature; the reaction mixture is washed with water, dried and concentrated to give, as an oil, 3-oxo-1-cyclohexen-1-yl 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate;

Into a reaction flask fitted with a drying tube are charged 3-oxo-1-cyclohexen-1-yl 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate, cyanoacetone and triethylamine, dissolved in a solvent and stirred continuously at room temperature; the solvent is distilled off, the mixture is extracted, washed with water, dried and concentrated to give tembotrione as a rice-yellow (beige) solid.

Into a 500 ml four-necked reaction flask fitted with a stirrer, a thermometer and a reflux condenser were charged 2-chlorotoluene 25.3 g (0.2 mol), anhydrous aluminium trichloride 40.5 g (0.3 mol) and 1,2-dichloroethane 150 ml; cooled to 5 degrees C, then methanesulfonyl chloride 25.25 g (0.22 mol) was added dropwise, the addition temperature not exceeding 10 degrees C; after the addition was complete the mixture was warmed to room temperature and the reaction continued for 10 h, followed by LC (liquid chromatography) until the reaction was complete; the reaction mixture was poured into ice water, the organic layer was separated, the aqueous layer was extracted with 1,2-dichloromethane, the organic phases were combined and concentrated to give a pale yellow solid 28.6 g, yield 84%.

Into a 500 ml four-necked reaction flask fitted with a stirrer, a thermometer and a condenser were charged methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate 55.8 g (0.2 mol), sodium trifluoroethoxide 28.1 g (0.23 mol) and 100 ml THF solvent; stirred at room temperature for 16 h, then washed with water and concentrated to give ethyl 2-chloro-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate; sodium hydroxide 9.2 g (0.23 mol) and water 10 ml were added and the mixture refluxed for 4 h. Title of invention: Synthesis process for the triketone-class herbicide tembotrione

Abstract. The present invention relates to a synthesis process for the triketone-class herbicide tembotrione, comprising the following steps: 1) synthesis of 2-chloro-6-(methanesulfonyl)toluene; 2) synthesis of 2-chloro-3-acetyl-6-(methanesulfonyl)toluene; 3) synthesis of 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid; 4) synthesis of methyl 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate; 5) synthesis of methyl 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate; 6) synthesis of 2-chloro-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid; 7) synthesis of 3-oxo-1-cyclohexen-1-yl 2-chloro-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate; 8) synthesis of tembotrione. The beneficial effects of the present invention are that: the reaction steps and time are shortened, and the yield of the intermediates is raised; the reaction conditions are milder and safer; the cost is lowered.

Abstract. The present invention relates to a synthesis process for the triketone-class herbicide tembotrione, comprising the following steps: 1) synthesis of 2-chloro-6-(methanesulfonyl)toluene; 2) synthesis of 2-chloro-3-acetyl-6-(methanesulfonyl)toluene; 3) synthesis of 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid; 4) synthesis of methyl 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate; 5) synthesis of methyl 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate; 6) synthesis of 2-chloro-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid; 7) synthesis of 3-oxo-1-cyclohexen-1-yl 2-chloro-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate; 8) synthesis of tembotrione. The beneficial effects of the present invention are that: the reaction steps and time are shortened, and the yield of the intermediates is raised; the reaction conditions are milder and safer; the cost is lowered.

1) Synthesis of 2-chloro-6-methylsulfonyltoluene

2-Chlorotoluene, the catalyst anhydrous aluminium trichloride and solvent are added to a reaction flask; methanesulfonyl chloride is added dropwise at between 0℃ and -15℃ [printed as 0℃-15℃, see notes]; after the dropwise addition is complete the mixture is warmed to room temperature and the reaction continued; LC is used to follow the reaction to completion; the reaction mixture is poured into ice water, extracted with solvent and concentrated to give 2-chloro-6-methylsulfonyltoluene;
2) Synthesis of 2-chloro-3-acetyl-6-methylsulfonyltoluene

2-Chloro-6-methylsulfonyltoluene, anhydrous aluminium trichloride and solvent are added to a reaction vessel; at a temperature of 15-20℃ acetyl chloride is added dropwise; after the dropwise addition is complete the reaction is continued at room temperature for 1-5h; when the reaction is complete the reaction mixture is poured into a mixture of ice water and hydrochloric acid; the organic layer is separated, the aqueous layer is extracted with solvent, the organic layers are combined, washed with water and concentrated to give 2-chloro-3-acetyl-6-methylsulfonyltoluene;
2) Synthesis of 2-chloro-3-acetyl-6-methylsulfonyltoluene

2-Chloro-6-methylsulfonyltoluene, anhydrous aluminium trichloride and solvent are added to a reaction vessel; at a temperature of 15-20℃ acetyl chloride is added dropwise; after the dropwise addition is complete the reaction is continued at room temperature for 1-5h; when the reaction is complete the reaction mixture is poured into a mixture of ice water and hydrochloric acid; the organic layer is separated, the aqueous layer is extracted with solvent, the organic layers are combined, washed with water and concentrated to give 2-chloro-3-acetyl-6-methylsulfonyltoluene;

3) Synthesis of 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid

The 2-chloro-3-acetyl-6-methylsulfonyltoluene obtained in step 2) and aqueous sodium hypochlorite solution are added separately to a reaction vessel fitted with a stirrer; the mixture is heated to react, acidified with dilute hydrochloric acid, filtered, washed with water and dried to give 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid;
4) Synthesis of methyl 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate

7) Synthesis of 3-oxo-1-cyclohexenyl 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate

A triketone maize-field herbicide developed by Bayer in 2007; its activity is higher than that of xiaohuanhuangtong [herbicide name exactly as printed; not a standard common name, identity unresolved] and mesotrione currently on the market, and it is safe to the crop. The beneficial effects of the present invention are: by improving the process, the reaction steps and time are shortened, and the yield of the intermediate methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate is raised; this process uses methanesulfonyl chloride in place of the chloro-substitution reaction of the methyl sulfide, doing away with the hydrogen-peroxide oxidation step of the thioether, which makes the reaction conditions milder and the production process safer; in the preparation of the methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate intermediate, bromine is used in place of expensive NBS to brominate the side-chain methyl group, which lowers the production cost.

Into a 500 ml four-necked reaction flask fitted with a stirrer, a thermometer and a reflux condenser were charged 2-chlorotoluene 25.3 g (0.2 mol), anhydrous aluminium trichloride 40.5 g (0.3 mol) and 1,2-dichloroethane 150 ml; cooled to 5 degrees C, then methanesulfonyl chloride 25.25 g (0.22 mol) was added dropwise, the addition temperature not exceeding 10 degrees C; after the addition was complete the mixture was warmed to room temperature and the reaction continued for 10 h, followed by LC (liquid chromatography) until the reaction was complete; the reaction mixture was poured into ice water, the organic layer was separated, the aqueous layer was extracted with 1,2-dichloromethane, the organic phases were combined and concentrated to give a pale yellow solid 28.6 g, yield 84%.
